reason: Both answers cover the key points: position on capacity/utilization forecasting, drop AI as the lead, shift to an economic buyer, and demote PM to context. Answer B commits to a recommendation on the layer vs replace fork (land as a layer, expand to replace), while A leaves it as an open fork. B adds validation steps that would change what the asker does next, such as checking why the best customers bought and comparing retention, and it flags the forecast-accuracy risk. A offers useful ICP and pricing detail, but it includes unsupported figures ("~80%" friction cut, specific per-head pricing) and unevidenced claims about competitors. B is more decision-ready and more careful.
